query: WITH entities AS ((SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE partner_id = $1 AND (id > $4) AND ($4 IS NOT NULL) AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contact_flags f WHERE f.contact_id = contacts.id) >= $2) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $3) UNION ALL (SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE partner_id = $1 AND ($4 IS NULL) AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contact_flags f WHERE f.contact_id = contacts.id) >= $2) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $3) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $3) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id!: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $5 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at, NULL::jsonb as "forgettable_payload?" FROM entities i JOIN contact_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.id asc, i.id, e.sequence
